title: Integration Principal
description:
**INTEGRATION PRINCIPAL**



(Pune)


*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud\-based procurement solutions.*


**COMPANY OVERVIEW**



At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.



We achieve this through our leading cloud\-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.



Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.


**THE OPPORTUNITY**


**CONTEXT**:



You will be part of the Professional Services Team whose mission is to successfully deliver our unique and configurable solution to customers and support our Partner community with high quality standards and a strong commitment to excellence and efficiency. Our team is very hands\-on with a strong mindset of problem\-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long\-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end\-to\-end spend management data solutions.


**ROLE**:



We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the **most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds** across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.



You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).



This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US**


**Integration Design \& Implementation**


* *End‑to‑End Integration Design:* Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* *Hands‑On Build:* Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* *Standards \& Reuse:* Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* *Performance \& Robustness:* Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* *Troubleshooting \& Debugging:* Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**


* *Work with Functional \& Technical Teams:* Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* *Customer Technical Workshops:* Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* *R\&D Feedback:* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* *Pre‑Sales Support:* Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.


**Delivery Excellence**


* *Technical Specifications:* Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* *Quality Assurance:* Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* *Risk \& Issue Management:* Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* *Lifecycle Support:* Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.


**Partner \& Internal Enablement**


* *Technical Mentor:* Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* *Partner Guidance:* Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* *Knowledge Assets:* Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.


**YOUR PROFILE**



If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:


**Required Skills**


* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve most the complex integration problems across applications, middleware, and databases.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and long‑term maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .
* Comfortable working in a customer‑facing Professional Services or consulting environment, managing multiple workstreams and priorities.
* A Bachelor's (BS) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field or foreign equivalent is required.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed (\~10–20%, depending on project needs).


**Preferred Skills**


* Experience in Procurement / Source‑to‑Pay (S2P), finance, or supply chain domains.
* Experience working with or alongside Systems Integrators (SIs) or consulting partners on integration topics.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and integration services (iPaaS, API gateways, message queues, event‑driven architectures).
* Familiarity with using automation or AI‑assisted tools for mapping, testing, or monitoring integrations.
* Relevant technical certifications in integration/middleware, cloud, or enterprise applications.


**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**



If your application fits this specific position's needs, our skilled Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screening call. Get one step closer to achieving your goals – apply today!



Our Talent team will guide you through every step of the interview process \- from preparation to completion. They're here to support you!



Our recruitment process is designed to assess your competencies through a series of personalised interviews with internal stakeholders relevant to the role.



Interviews will be conducted virtually via video or on\-site with face\-to\-face meetings.


**LIFE AT IVALUA**


* Hybrid working model (3 days in the office per week)
* We're a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of product innovation and technology
* Sustainable Growth, Privately Held
* A stable and cash\-flow positive Company since 10 years
* Snacks and weekly lunches in the office
* Feel empowered to pursue your goals with improved team collaboration and increased creativity/productivity
* Unlock and unleash your full professional potential with our exceptional training and career development program
* Join a dynamic and international team of top\-notch professionals who are experts in their respective fields. Collaborate with like\-minded individuals who are deeply passionate and highly motivated about their work. Experience a truly diverse and inclusive work environment where your unique contributions are highly valued
* Regular social events, competitive outings, team running events, and musical activities,
* Comparably recognized Ivalua for the following (https://www.comparably.com/companies/ivalua) :

  


  



**Powered by People \- Powered by You!**



United by our values we embrace diversity and equity in the broadest possible sense to create an inclusive workplace. To help our customers make supply chains more efficient, sustainable and resilient, we rely on a global team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. We believe in equal opportunity and in diversity as a driver of innovation that cultivates a spirit of inclusiveness, creates a productive and fun place to work, and provides fulfilling career opportunities for all Ivaluans. https://www.linkedin.com/company/ivalua/about/


**Experience life at Ivalua \- check out our captivating****video****! Gain insight into our unique company culture and get a glimpse of what it's like to work with us.**

Job Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Real Estate Pre\-Sales ASM to join our team.  Project Coordination: Work closely with the sales, marketing, and project teams to ensure all information provided to potential buyers is accurate and up\-to\-date.

 Reporting: Track and report on the progress of leads, inquiries, and customer feedback to management.

 Event Management: Assist in organizing pre\-sales events, property exhibitions, and site visits to showcase upcoming projects to potential clients.

 Sales Support: Provide support to the sales team in closing deals once the pre\-sales phase transitions into active sales.

 Collaborative and dynamic work environment with a strong team culture.

 Access to cutting\-edge tools and resources to succeed in your role.

title: Microsoft Data & AI Consultant
description:
Pune, India
#### **Position Summary**


Zelite is hiring a Microsoft AI Consultant to design, build, and deliver AI solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem for enterprise clients – spanning Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, and the Power Platform. The consultant will work alongside Zelite’s Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and data delivery teams to scope AI use cases, build proofs of concept, and lead client\-facing AI implementations.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design and implement AI\-driven data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Power BI
* Build and deploy Copilot Studio agents and Microsoft 365 Copilot extensions integrated with Dataverse, SharePoint, and line\-of\-business systems
* Architect and develop generative AI solutions using Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI Service, prompt flow, model orchestration)
* Extend Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate) with AI Builder and custom AI models
* Translate client business requirements into AI solution architecture, scoping documents, and technical proposals
* Lead client discovery workshops to identify AI use cases and quantify ROI
* Collaborate with the Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and BI teams to embed AI capabilities into existing client implementations
* Track the evolving Microsoft AI ecosystem and assess new capabilities for client applicability
* Partner with the sales and pre\-sales teams on client demos, effort/cost estimation, and delivery planning for new opportunities and proposals

#### **Required Technical Skills**


* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric – Data Factory, Lakehouse, Data Engineering, and Real\-Time Analytics
* Strong understanding of OneLake architecture and data lake design patterns
* Experience migrating legacy application/data warehouse workloads to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including workspace, semantic model, and capacity migration
* Experience building and deploying Copilot Studio agents (custom topics, generative answers, plugin/action integration)
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility – Copilot agents, declarative agents, Graph connectors
* Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, including Azure OpenAI Service, prompt engineering, and model deployment/orchestration
* Experience optimizing AI and Fabric resource consumption – capacity unit (CU) usage, Azure OpenAI token/cost management, and query/pipeline performance tuning
* Power Platform AI tooling – AI Builder, Power Automate AI flows, Copilot in Power Apps
* Familiarity with Dataverse as a data layer for AI solutions
* Power BI, including AI\-powered visuals and Copilot in Power BI
* Understanding of Azure Machine Learning and/or Azure AI (Cognitive) Services is a plus

#### **Qualifications and Experience**


* 4\-7 years of experience in Microsoft cloud, data, or AI consulting/solution delivery – a mid\-level position (Consultant/Senior Consultant), not entry\-level or a principal/lead role
* At least 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience with generative AI or Copilot\-based solutions
* Relevant Microsoft certifications preferred: DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), AI\-102 (Azure AI Engineer), PL\-400 or PL\-600 (Power Platform), or equivalent
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Prior experience in a client\-facing consulting environment

#### **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**


* Experience with Dynamics 365 (Sales, Business Central, Field Service, Sales, F\&O etc.)
* Exposure to broader Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Azure DevOps)
* Familiarity with other Microsoft AI offerings – Security Copilot, Sales Copilot, GitHub Copilot
* Industry domain experience (manufacturing, pharma, FMCG, or professional services)
* Experience with agentic AI or multi\-agent orchestration frameworks

#### **Soft Skills and Other Requirements**


* Strong client\-facing communication and presentation skills
* Ability to translate technical AI concepts for non\-technical business stakeholders
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-client consulting environment
* Self\-driven, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements

#### **Submit the application on:**


* sandeep.s@zelitesolutions.com
* divyani.c@zelitesolutions.com
* hr@zelitesolutions.com

description:
### **General Information**

Job ID
36212

**We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check to see whether the role you are interested in is posted here, on our website.**

  

**About TMF Group**
TMF Group is a leading global provider of high\-value business services to clients operating and investing globally. We focus on providing specialized and business\-critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds in different geographical locations.


TMF India is a Great Place to Work, ISO \& ISAE certified organization.

  

  

**Discover the Role**
The role focuses on delivering high\-quality HR and payroll integration solutions for global clients. It supports TMF’s Client Integration \& Migration team in designing and implementing fit\-for\-purpose integrations across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with local compliance requirements while enhancing the global HRP (Human Resource Platform) offering.


The position combines HR/payroll expertise with systems integration capability, helping clients adopt and migrate HCM (Human Capital Management) solutions such as Workday, Oracle, and SAP.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
### **1\. Integration Delivery \& Client Support**

* Provide expert advice on integration solutions tailored to client requirements
* Support implementation and rollout of integrations, including new features
* Collaborate with onboarding teams and clients to ensure best\-fit solutions
* Assist in multi\-country HR system integrations and migrations

### **2\. Solution Development \& Optimization**

* Design, improve, and maintain integration frameworks and solutions
* Conduct periodic reviews and recommend process improvements
* Manage country\-specific deviations and system enhancements
* Develop mapping documents for data transformation across systems

### **3\. Project \& Stakeholder Management**

* Lead business requirement gathering and blueprinting phases
* Support complex client transformation projects
* Track, escalate, and resolve integration risks and issues
* Work with internal teams, IT, and local offices globally

### **4\. Technical Expertise \& Innovation**

* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for integration solutions
* Support API\-based integrations (SOAP/REST) and ETL processes
* Ensure proper documentation and conduct training/webinars
* Contribute to improving TMF’s global HRP offering

### **5\. Pre\-Sales \& Knowledge Sharing**

* Support pre\-sales engagements and client presentations
* Promote integration capabilities internally and externally
* Share knowledge and best practices across teams
  

  

**Key Requirements**
### **Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of APIs, Web Services (SOAP/REST)
* Experience with Workday, Oracle, or SAP integrations
* Understanding of SQL, ETL processes, XML/XSLT
* Familiarity with integration platforms (Workday Cloud Connect, Oracle Integration Cloud, SAP CPI)
* Proficiency in MS Visio, PowerPoint, and documentation tools
* Experience with Agile methodology and version control (Git/SVN)

### **Project Management Skills**

* Ability to manage project timelines, risks, and deliverables
* Experience maintaining project documentation and reporting
* Strong coordination with stakeholders across regions
* Ability to lead issue resolution and lessons learned processes

### **Core Competencies**

* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work in a consultative, client\-facing role
* Experience collaborating in a global matrix environment
* Skilled in requirements gathering and stakeholder management
* Adaptability to hybrid work and international collaboration

### **Experience \& Qualifications**

* Minimum 5\+ years experience in HCM/ERP integrations
* Hands\-on experience with Workday HCM integrations (certification preferred)
* Understanding of payroll processes
* Proven experience working with both technical and functional stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
  

  

**What’s in it for you?**
**Pathways for career development**

* Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
* We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
* Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.
**Making an impact**

* You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
* Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.
**A supportive environment**

* Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.
* Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey.
* Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work\-life balance to perform at your best.
* At TMF Group, it’s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability.
**Other Benefits**

* Anniversary \& Birthday Leave policy
* Be part of One TMF
* Paternity \& Adoption leaves
* Salary advance policy
* Work flexibility – Hybrid work model
* Talk about growth opportunities (we invest in talent)
* Well\-being initiatives
  

  

**We’re looking forward to getting to know you!**
